abstract: Maintains wash bay environmental approvals, closed-loop recycling records, and industrial discharge permits
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENV). Your responsibilities include maintaining wash bay environmental approvals, closed-loop recycling records, and industrial discharge permits, as well as overseeing wayside acoustic barrier monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Wayside acoustic barrier monitoring（NOIS）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOIS-0FV：Acoustic boundary monitoring survey data for the Keystone Fleet Maintenance Facility indicates that the depot boundary nocturnal sound exposure level measured at the facility fence line between 22:00 and 06:00 is 64 dB.
ENV-NOIS-GQ5：Perimeter noise sensor network measurements between 22:00 and 06:00 show that the depot boundary nocturnal sound exposure level for the Susquehanna Rolling Stock Center is 52 dB.
ENV-NOIS-EJY：According to the acoustic boundary monitoring survey, the depot boundary nocturnal sound exposure level at the Penn Central Overhaul Works perimeter sensor network between 22:00 and 06:00 is 58 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains wash bay environmental approvals, closed-loop recycling records, and industrial discharge permits（WASH）
information_points.content:
ENV-WASH-GZD：Penn Central Overhaul Works possesses valid bogie wash bay environmental compliance clearance for closed-loop effluent recycling across its industrial bogie aqueous degreasing wash bay according to state environmental protection agency discharge permit documentation.
ENV-WASH-KPE：Records from the state environmental protection agency discharge permit indicate that Susquehanna Rolling Stock Center does not possess bogie wash bay environmental compliance clearance for its industrial bogie aqueous degreasing wash bay.
ENV-WASH-HQS：For the Keystone Fleet Maintenance Facility, state environmental protection agency discharge permit records confirm that the depot industrial bogie aqueous degreasing wash bay holds an affirmative bogie wash bay environmental compliance clearance for closed-loop effluent recycling.
